triggers.definition:
CREATE TRIGGER bsv_canonical_restroom_insert BEFORE INSERT ON bathrooms
        WHEN NEW.id NOT GLOB (NEW.store_id || '-RESTROOM-[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]')
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'noncanonical restroom_id'); END
triggers.name: bsv_canonical_restroom_insert

triggers.definition:
CREATE TRIGGER bsv_immutable_restroom_key BEFORE UPDATE OF id,store_id ON bathrooms
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'restroom_id/store_id immutable'); END
triggers.name: bsv_immutable_restroom_key
